notes: Declared intent only: the three Railway services run these fixed image tags and nothing upgrades them by itself. A version changes only by an operator editing the image tags and accepting the deploy (docs/runbooks/hindsight-upgrade.md). scripts/hindsight-lag.ts compares this pin with upstream releases weekly and keeps one issue open while a newer stable release has existed for lag_alert_days. Update this file in a pull request after an upgrade or a rollback.
